editorial:
The queue lists 'The Ghost' as a 1915 US film, but my searches found no record of it. The title is common, and I could not tell it apart from similar 1915 releases such as Lubin's 'The Ghost of Twisted Oaks' (released 11 November 1915). I am therefore not stating a studio, cast or plot for it.

The print rests on term expiry alone, because a film published in 1915 is past the US term. That does not cover a modern score or new titles added to a transfer, and the story layer is unchecked. Confirm which film this is, and what it was adapted from, before relying on any copy.
